entities.name: Rebbec
entities.description: Chief architect of the Thran Empire's capital Halcyon, wife of Glacian; she sealed Yawgmoth and the Phyrexians away from Dominaria.

entities.name: Glacian
entities.description: Master artificer and husband of Rebbec, sickened by powerstone radiation.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: A eugenicist who rose to power in the Thran Empire and sought to make Phyrexia his paradise.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: One of the Untouchables who stabbed Glacian with a powerstone.

entities.name: Dyfed
entities.description: A planeswalker who cracked a powerstone to open a portal to Phyrexia and was later vivisected by Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Halcyon
entities.description: Capital of the Thran Empire on Dominaria.

entities.name: Thran Empire
entities.description: The empire whose capital was Halcyon.

entities.name: The 28 leaders
entities.description: Group of proven leaders who decide matters if the council of elders cannot agree.

entities.name: Untouchables
entities.description: A group living under the Mana Rig who contracted powerstone disease and rebelled.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The plane Yawgmoth wanted to make his paradise.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane of the Thran Empire.

entities.name: Gamalgoth
entities.description: The first city of Phyrexia, which grew from Rebbec's infirmary.

entities.name: Thran Temple
entities.description: A gigantic structure hovering over Halcyon built by Rebbec.

entities.name: Iachem-oath
entities.description: In Mercadian myth, the husband of Arabeka.

events.summary: Gix stabbed Glacian with a powerstone, making him ill.
events.quote: When her husband was stabbed with a powerstone by Gix

events.summary: Rebbec used her influence to have Yawgmoth return from exile to cure Glacian.
events.quote: Rebbec used her influence to have the eugenicist Yawgmoth return from exile.

events.summary: Yawgmoth diluted the serum given to the Untouchables to provoke another insurrection and took over the Halcyte Guard.
events.quote: He deliberately diluted the serum he was giving to the Untouchables to cause another insurrection

events.summary: Yawgmoth and Rebbec began falling in love without acting on it.
events.quote: Rebbec and Yawgmoth started falling in love, although neither of them acted upon it.

events.summary: Yawgmoth overthrew the council and imprisoned its elders and the delegates after the vote on his stay split evenly.
events.quote: He immediately overthrew the council and imprisoned its elders, as well as the delegates.

events.summary: Dyfed cracked a powerstone to open a permanent portal from Dominaria to Phyrexia, and Rebbec built an infirmary there.
events.quote: the planeswalker Dyfed cracked a powerstone to open a permanent portal from Dominaria to Phyrexia

events.summary: Yawgmoth merged himself with Rebbec on Phyrexia and proposed they rule together; she refused.
Rebbec found Dyfed stabbed in the skull for vivisection and removed the knife, letting her die.
events.quote: The disgusted Rebbec removed the knife, allowing Dyfed to die

events.summary: Rebbec returned to find Glacian dead and Halcyon devastated by Yawgmoth's cloud of energy.
events.quote: She found Glacian dead and discovered the powerstones Yawgmoth had implanted in him.

events.summary: Rebbec placed the powerstone on the pedestal to seal Yawgmoth and the Phyrexians away from Dominaria, then ascended into the white cloud.
events.quote: This would seal Yawgmoth and the Phyrexians away from their home plane of Dominaria.

relations.quote: She was the wife of master artificer Glacian .
When her husband was stabbed with a powerstone by Gix

relations.note: Sealed him away after falling out with him.
relations.quote: This would seal Yawgmoth and the Phyrexians away from their home plane of Dominaria.

relations.note: Both she and Glacian were members.
relations.quote: Both were part of the 28 leaders

relations.note: In Mercadian myth, as Arabeka she is his wife.
relations.quote: she is known as "Arabeka" and is the queen of heaven and the wife of Iachem-oath
